alley.name: Rain-Slicked Alley
alley.description: The neon signs of the city blur in the rain. A high-security ventilation shaft is the only way in.

vent_shaft.name: Ventilation Shaft
vent_shaft.description: Cramped and metallic. You can hear the hum of servers nearby. The shaft leads further in or back to the alley.

server_room.name: Central Server Room
server_room.description: Columns of blinking blue lights stretch into the darkness. A master terminal controls the security grid.

vault.name: The Data Vault
vault.description: A sterile, white room. In the center sits the Data Core, protected by a laser grid.

deck.name: Deck
deck.description: A modified hacking deck. Essential for bypassing security.

data_core.name: Data Core
data_core.description: The target. A glowing cylinder containing the corporation's darkest secrets.

interactions.message: You jack into the terminal. After a frantic sequence of commands, the laser grids in the vault hiss and power down. SECURITY DISABLED.
You carefully extract the Data Core. With the security down, you slip back out through the vents and vanish into the neon rain. MISSION ACCOMPLISHED!
You try to grab the core, but the laser grid incinerates your hand! You barely escape back to the server room.
